title: A preorder unit contracts its bar reindexing
statement: Let I be a preorder and A a preadditive category with coproducts in the universes of I and Nat. Let f:I→I be monotone with i≤f(i), and D:I→CochainComplex(A,Int). The bar endomorphism induced by f and the coefficient maps D(i≤f(i)) [def-sc-preorder-bar-total] is homotopic to identity.

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: For insertion position a, duplicate the vertex σ(a), retain vertices before it, and apply f to the vertices after it. The inequality σ(a)≤f(σ(a)) makes this a monotone string. The coefficient map is the identity, since the first vertex is unchanged. Check all face and degeneracy identities by deleting or repeating vertices before, at, and after the insertion. This gives a simplicial homotopy from identity to unit reindexing. Mathlib turns its alternating sum into a horizontal chain homotopy; horizontalHomotopy totalizes it.
